key_notes: Key 1 (t=8.0s): Initial archival pose of camel; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=9.12s): Mid-sequence articulation of camel; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=10.36s): Peak dynamic extension of camel over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=11.6s): Follow-through and settle of camel with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of camel (8.0s..11.6s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
